svg.title: Fleet Planners — Who Chooses the Routes?

g.text: Fleet Planners — Who Chooses the Routes?
For each train, run its own path search
Other trains do not affect its initial route
Route each train using earlier trains'
Event risk is included when Adaptive
Refine the fleet routes with dry-run cost
and expected event delay when supplied
Branch: forbid that rail for train A
or forbid it for train B
without it there are no modeled
CLI: Cooperative/CBS default to Adaptive unless a path mode is explicit.
--lines is an independent track-safety option, not a planner.
Reconsider only trains not yet departed
Switch once per train only when own gain
is at least 30 s and no greater than
Rail event during a cooperative/CBS run?
